reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of lattice distortions hindering dislocation motion and altering phonon scattering is well-grounded in established RHEA theory and experimental evidence.
reasons.testability: A controlled comparison with direct structural and mechanical measurements at high temperature provides a clear, decisive method to confirm or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: Verifying the role of lattice distortions under realistic service conditions is directly valuable to alloy design and optimization for high-temperature applications.
